# Reverse parser admission: known legacy syntax and diagnostic recovery.

FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:fiber-function-name grammar-lab Appendix A Name: a declaration's own name takes the enclosing context's parameters, so effect function join() {} at module level derives; the lab applies [+Effect] to every name after effect; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:fiber-function-name grammar-lab Appendix A Name: effect function join(p) derives as a module-level declaration; the lab does not model it yet; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:fork-block compiler VIP-17: a bare fork brace-body containing statements is not a UnaryExpression operand; the compiler wraps it in a program and accepts it; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:fork-block compiler VIP-17: bare fork block statements have no Appendix A derivation; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:for-concurrent-line-break compiler Appendix A: `concurrent` is a keyword only before `(` on the same line; a line break after `concurrent` still compiles as the loop; lane impl-hunt-admission

FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:try-in-generator compiler VIP-5 and Appendix B EK0501: `try` outside effect code is an error; in a plain generator it reports only the operand error EK0502; lane impl-hunt-admission

FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:data-separators compiler Appendix A: DataDeclaration has one Separator between variants and an optional last one; `data D { A; ; B }` and `data D { ; A }` compile; lane impl-hunt-admission

FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:join-for-head compiler VIP-17: join is exactly as await, and TypeScript rejects `for (await x of xs)` with TS2487; `for (join x of xs)` reports only the operand error EK4611; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:join-for-head compiler VIP-17: join is exactly as await, and TypeScript rejects `for (await x of xs)` with TS2487; `for (join x of xs)` reports only the operand error EK4611; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:join-for-head-line-break compiler VIP-17: join's operand may follow a line break, as after await; `for (join\nx of xs)` reports only EK4611 where the await twin is TS2487; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:is-operand-precedence compiler VIP-7 and the pinned TC39 grammar: RelationalExpression [no LineTerminator here] `is` MatchPattern makes an is expression a RelationalExpression, which can't be the left operand of +, * or <<; the compiler reads `x is 1 + 1` as `(x is 1) + 1` and reports only TS2365; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:is-operand-precedence compiler VIP-7 and the pinned TC39 grammar: RelationalExpression [no LineTerminator here] `is` MatchPattern makes an is expression a RelationalExpression, which can't be the left operand of +, * or <<; the compiler reads `x is 1 + 1` as `(x is 1) + 1` and reports only TS2365; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:service-separators compiler Appendix A: ServiceDeclaration separates members as interface members, one Separator after each; `service S { n: number; ; m: string }` compiles; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:service-separators compiler Appendix A: ServiceDeclaration separates members as interface members, one Separator after each; `service S { n: number; ; m: string }` compiles; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:effect-type-slot-line-break compiler Appendix A: EffectType has [no LineTerminator here] before each slot; `number ! string !` then `boolean` on the next line compiles as one A!E!R; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:or-binding-reserved-name compiler Appendix A MatchPattern binding is `let` BindingIdentifier, which excludes strict-mode reserved words (TS1214, as tsc reports for `let let`); inside an or or not pattern the compiler reports only EK4702 and drops the name, so TS1214 is lost; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:or-binding-reserved-name compiler Appendix A MatchPattern binding is `let` BindingIdentifier, which excludes strict-mode reserved words (TS1214, as tsc reports for `let let`); inside an or or not pattern the compiler reports only EK4702 and drops the name, so TS1214 is lost; lane impl-hunt-admission
